SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: COMPENSATION AND PERFORMANCE ARE REVIEWED ANNUALLY THROUGH A STRUCTURED, WRITTEN EVALUATION PROCESS. PAYSCALE.COM IS USED TO BENCHMARK COMPENSATION LEVELS, PROVIDING MARKET COMPARISONS OF TOTAL CASH COMPENSATION FOR SIMILAR ROLES AT FIRMS OF COMPARABLE TYPE AND SIZE, BOTH WITHIN AND OUTSIDE THE ABILITYONE PROGRAM. IN ADDITION, AN INDEPENDENT FIRM CONDUCTS A COMPREHENSIVE SEMI-ANNUAL COMPENSATION STUDY FOR KEY MANAGEMENT PERSONNEL, WITH THE MOST RECENT STUDY COMPLETED IN JULY 2023. BASED ON THESE ASSESSMENTS, THE CEO SUBMITS COMPENSATION RECOMMENDATIONS TO THE BOARD FOR REVIEW, OVERSIGHT, AND APPROVAL
